title: The FairCeptron: A Framework for Measuring Human Perceptions of Algorithmic Fairness
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It introduces a framework for studying human perceptions of algorithmic fairness, using gender as the primary example for a protected attribute.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion/faith; therefore, there are no findings related to this topic.
